title: Infantry Marines Take To The Air
description: Marines with Third Battalion, Third Marine Regiment conducted training with CH-46E Sea Knight helicopters. The Marines were tasked with gathering intelligence, then performing an emergency evacuation. Lance Corporal Natalie Rostran took a ride to the landing zone for a first hand look at the Marines in action.
